notes.title: Demo Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Hello,

we've uploaded an update which fixes a rare crash during the battles. We've also balanced some attacking waves. Getting to the final wave is now easier.

notes.title: Hotfix for demo
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've uploaded a small hotfix which fixes an error while loading the game. You should now no longer be stuck on the "loading military" screen.

notes.title: Demo Update for Steam Next
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We've updated our demo for the Steam Next Festival, fixing some errors and improving several aspects:

[list]
[*]  Fixed a bug with the market which prohibited players from buying goods
[*]  Fixed a bug that sometimes broke soldier formations too early 
[*]  Improved some graphics
[*]  Mage fireballs look like actual fireballs now. With sound! 
[*]  Improved some events
[*]  Made the game slightly easier. It's still quite challenging. 
[*]  Implemented the missing buildings
[*]  You can now win the game! Just build a temple. Easy!
[/list]

notes.title: We will participate in Steam Next Fest: June 2023!
notes.notes:
Hey there!
We have some exciting news to share with you. Altwaldheim 2 will be featured in Steam Next Fest: June 2023, starting next Monday! We're also releasing a patch for the demo which fixes many bugs. If you haven't tried it out yet, make sure to give it a go!
We'd love to hear your thoughts and answer any questions you may have. Feel free to contact us through the Steam forums or Discord at https://discord.gg/g4R8D6e.
Thanks for your support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello friends. 

We are alive and still working on Altwaldheim 2. The demo is out, but there are some things we want to improve. Today, we have a small update for you, fixing several issues: 

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when having large armies
[*] Fixed missing sprites for some units (they appeared as white squares during battles)
[*] Fixed some missing texts in both the German and English versions
[*] Fixed some typos. 
[*] Changed the trading system. There is no longer a limited amount of transactions. The system was too janky. When you upgrade your marketplace, the ordering time will reduce from 4 weeks to 3 weeks  
[/list]
[b]
Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trolls love changing their skin. Not intended though. 
[*] The game is not intended for battles with more than 10k units. It will look weird and ugly if you manage to recruit that many soldiers. 
[*] The sound and music options are not saved between games,
[/list]
[b]
Plans for future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implement the embassy and temple. They have no functions at the moment
[*] Balancing
[*] Add more enemy waves for longer gameplay
[*] Add more sounds in the battles, e.g. units dying
[*] Add more events
[*] Add options to increase battle speed
[/list]

That's it for today. Feel free to contact us any times in the steam forum or in discord: https://discord.gg/g4R8D6e  

Have a nice day!
[i]Ludlus[/i]

notes.title: Altwaldheim 2: Town in Trouble
notes.notes:
[b]We are proud to finally announce Altwaldheim 2: Town in Trouble. 
[/b]

It has been almost three years since I released Altwaldheim 1 back in 2020. So what happened in the last few years? It has been quite a journey. As you probably guessed, the big C-word also affected me. I finished my studies and had no idea what to do now in these weird, isolated times. So, I did the only logical thing:
We founded the company Ascendancy Games. Our goal is to create engaging and fun games surrounding the world of Nerus, to which Altwaldheim also belongs. Our games are easy to learn and understand but hard to master. 

We also started developing the sequel. Altwaldheim 2 revamps and reworks many aspects of the first game. It also adds new features, like a real-time auto-battle system, in which up to thousands of enemies fight each other until one army remains. Or new custom music, done by the great Jan Pfitzer. 

Check out the demo! And please wishlist and follow the game! It is available in German and English.

I would like to thank everybody that played the first Altwaldheim and gave valuable feedback. I hope you will enjoy the sequel as well!

 
We also have social media. I heard that is something you need these days. 

Discord:   https://discord.gg/g4R8D6e
Twitter:    https://twitter.com/info_ascendancy

Feel free to contact us any time. I will also keep an eye on the steam forum. 


Have fun! 
[i]Ludlus
[/i]

tldr: New game Altwaldheim 2. Check out the demo! And don't forget to wishlist!
